items.definition:
the action of making something lawful
The debate over the legalization of certain substances continues.

the competence or skill expected of a professional
Her professionalism was evident in every aspect of her work.

a doubting or questioning attitude
There was widespread skepticism about the new policy.

angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues; conflict
The country was torn by political strife.

the quality of using money and other resources carefully and not wastefully
Her grandmother taught her the importance of thrift.

a person who supports Zionism, the movement for the re-establishment and development and protection of a Jewish nation in what is now Israel
He identified himself as a Zionist.

the condition of being unknown
The witness was granted anonymity for their safety.

the action of taking something for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission or for public use
The appropriation of funds for the new project was approved.

a concentrated artillery bombardment over a wide area; an overwhelming quantity of questions or criticisms
The politician faced a barrage of questions from the reporters.

the hundredth anniversary of a significant event
The town celebrated its centenary with a grand parade.

a numerical or constant quantity placed before and multiplying the variable in an algebraic expression
In the equation, 'x' is the variable and '2' is the coefficient.

a large corporation formed by the merger of separate companies
The media conglomerate owns several television networks and newspapers.

a person held in custody, especially for political reasons
The human rights organization advocated for the release of the political detainee.

A real or imagined wrong or cause for complaint.
He filed a formal grievance against his employer.

A feeling that makes one self-conscious and unable to act in a relaxed and natural way.
Alcohol can lower your inhibitions.

An advocate or supporter of Islamic militancy or fundamentalism.
The government is concerned about the rise of Islamist groups.

The repetition of a process or utterance.
This is the third iteration of the software.

a short, pithy statement expressing a general truth or rule of conduct
"Honesty is the best policy" is a well-known maxim.

a feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause
A sense of melancholy filled the room after the news.

the process of combining with oxygen
Rust is a common example of iron oxidation.

an unintended consequence of an event or action
His actions had serious repercussions for the entire team.

the part of the mind of which one is not fully aware but which influences one's actions and feelings
Dreams often reveal thoughts from the subconscious.

a mass of new tissue that grows in a body, often associated with cancer
The doctors found a small tumour in his lung.

an imagined place or state of things in which everything is perfect
Many people dream of living in a perfect utopia.

difficulties; misfortune
She showed great resilience in the face of adversity.

a written statement confirmed by oath or affirmation, for use as evidence in court
The witness signed an affidavit confirming her statement.

a foolish, outrageous, or amusing act
The clown's antics made the children laugh.

a female baron or a baron's wife
The baroness hosted a lavish ball at her estate.

organic matter used as a fuel, especially in a power station for the generation of electricity
Burning biomass can be a source of renewable energy.

the action of damaging the good reputation of someone; slander or libel
He sued the newspaper for defamation of character.

a conductor through which electricity enters or leaves an object, substance, or region
The battery has a positive and a negative electrode.

uncontrollable emotion or excitement
The crowd erupted in mass hysteria after the goal.

a policy of extending a country's power and influence through colonization
Many historical conflicts were driven by imperialism.

the unlawful killing of another person without malice aforethought
He was charged with involuntary manslaughter.

punishment inflicted in return for an injury or wrong
The victims sought retribution for the injustice.

the male reproductive fluid
Semen contains sperm and other fluids.

the right to vote in political elections
Women's suffrage was a major movement in the early 20th century.

a substitute, especially a person deputizing for another in a specific role or office
She acted as a surrogate mother for her sister.

a formal written work
He wrote a lengthy treatise on political philosophy.

severe mental or physical pain or suffering
He felt great anguish over the loss of his pet.

laws against monopolies
The company faced an antitrust investigation.

a type of lawyer in the UK
The barrister presented his case to the judge.

the business of a broker
He works for a large brokerage firm.

a neurotransmitter that plays a role in pleasure and reward.
Exercise can release dopamine, improving mood.

a rebel or revolutionary
The government forces fought against the insurgents.

a powerful pain-relieving drug
Morphine is used in medicine to relieve severe pain.

a state of perfect happiness and peace in Buddhism
In Buddhism, the ultimate goal is to achieve nirvana.

military weapons, ammunition, and equipment
The army's ordnance depot stores all its weapons.

the state of being completely full or soaked
The market has reached saturation point for smartphones.

great sorrow or distress
The country was plunged into economic woe.

the act of crediting
Proper attribution is essential when citing sources.

the study of chemical processes in living organisms
She is studying biochemistry at university.

a supporter of King Charles I in the English Civil War
The Cavaliers fought against the Roundheads.

The state of being confined in prison; imprisonment.
The judge ordered his incarceration for five years.

Sexual relations between people who are too closely related to marry.
The novel dealt with the difficult topic of incest.

A person who plans and directs an intricate and complex project or activity
He was the mastermind behind the entire operation.

Data that provides information about other data
The metadata helps organize the digital files.

The part of a vehicle's load that consists of goods or passengers; the explosive warhead of a missile
The rocket carried a scientific payload into space.

severe physical or mental suffering
He endured years of torment.

a cruel and oppressive ruler
The people rebelled against the tyrant.

the presentation of something as being smaller, worse, or less important than it actually is
To say it was difficult would be an understatement.

the process of being united or made into a whole
The unification of the two countries was a historic event.

weapons collectively
The country is investing heavily in modern weaponry.

a fixed sum of money paid to someone each year, typically for the rest of their life
He invested in an annuity to ensure a steady income in retirement.
